findings.issue: Meaning is right and unambiguous in all three slots this key feeds (scope segment, roster source chip, detail meta line), and the set no longer overflows - but shipped ru names this source 'из хаба' in 25 values across ui.hub.updates, ui.hub.links, ui.agents.navigation and ui.chat, including the same short source-label slot (ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.remote, 'The hub's' -> 'Из хаба'). At HEAD only two values used 'с хаба', one of them verb-governed ('сняли с хаба'); this delta adds the two other occurrences, so the installed-source label now reads differently from the same concept everywhere else. 'С хаба' is idiomatic developer Russian too, and it is 6.91 px narrower, so the shorter form is a defensible width call rather than an error; 'Из хаба' was measured in the same rig at 237.15 px natural sum, i.e. it still fits the 246 px row (8.85 px slack, no well scroll) but misses the remediation's 14 px / 232 px margin by 5.15 px. Not gating: adopt 'Из хаба' only if the team prefers cross-surface consistency over the extra margin, and re-capture the frame if it does; otherwise keep 'С хаба' and record it as a width-driven call in the ru style guide's recorded-exception list.
findings.rationale: No shorter true participle exists in the budget - 'Установленные' 109.48 px box, 'Установлено' 93.19, 'Скачанные' 83.14, 'Загружено' 81.52 - and 'Штатные' was rejected on the встроен- family consistency that this same key's chip use makes binding, so a prepositional origin phrase is the right class of fix, not a terminology compromise.

findings.issue: Grammatical, impersonal (which the ru guide prefers), true in the only state that renders it (agents-page.tsx:788-794 routes any search to empty.search, so the sentence appears only when the installed scope is genuinely empty), and it echoes the segment label well. The only cost is shape: its siblings are nominal genitive + нет ('Своих агентов нет.', 'Встроенных агентов нет.'), while this one is a verbal clause. A parallel alternative would be 'Агентов с хаба нет.'; style only, and I would not spend a round on it.
findings.rationale: The context note asks that installed stay distinct from custom and built-in, which the current wording does; the divergence is therefore acceptable as it stands.

observations: The scope group's screen-reader legend stays 'Чьи определения показывать' ('whose definitions'), while the segment now names origin; English has the same mismatch ('Installed' under 'Show definitions owned by') and the delta did not touch the legend, so this is recorded, not raised.

Consistency sweep detail: 'хаб' is a settled ru transliteration across the catalogues (96 values, incl. 'Хаб агентов' as a page title and mid-sentence 'в хабе'), and 'установлен-' is the settled state vocabulary elsewhere ('Навыки не установлены.', 'Установлено: {path}'), so neither the noun nor the verb introduced by this delta is a new term.
fr is modified in the same worktree but is out of this receipt's scope; nothing here should be read as a verdict on it.

verdict.summary: No blocker or major: the fit fix preserves meaning in every slot the key feeds, introduces no overflow, and keeps the namespace mechanically clean. One minor (preposition variant vs the shipped 'из хаба') and one nit (empty-state shape vs its siblings) are recorded and answered; neither needs a remediation round.
